quality_target: P1.5 official F1(B=two-stage 2+4) minus F1(A=standalone top2), with a secondary 2+2 sensitivity
fallback: Retain raw error. If the relationship record fails validation or no claim can be scored, diagnostic selection falls back to V2 whole-question NLI plus its locked bridge proxy gate. Local r and g are unmodified nullable observations.
scope: Development-only diagnostic. Keep fixed P1.5 A/B and all upstream prompts unchanged. Test V2-style direct 2+2 and 2+4 once each as independent cost/quality baselines. No new B query, no training, no final labels, no threshold optimization.
